question_text: Fill in the blanks with suitable prepositions, article and zero articles. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: Many people long (a) ⎯⎯ wealth. They think wealth brings (b) ⎯⎯ happiness. But often wealth brings (c) ⎯⎯ great deal of worry instead (d) ⎯⎯ happiness. Most of the people forget that great wealth is also (e) ⎯⎯ great responsibility. Moreover, a very rich man (f) ⎯⎯ spite of his great wealth, may not have (g) ⎯⎯ easy life. We should bear (h) ⎯⎯ mind that we live in society. So we must learn how to live (i) ⎯⎯ peace and amity (j) ⎯⎯ others. We should not feel proud for wealth.
guide_solution: (a) era (b) mega (c) without (d) off (e) considering (f) trade (g) tourism (h) growth (i) the (j) dream
